name: Dagger Swarm, Lesser
body:
School conjuration [summoning]; Level: sorcerer/wizard/summoner 3, witch 3

Components: V,S

Casting Time: 1 round

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Effect: One 10 ft. swarm of daggers

Duration: concentration + 2 rounds

Saving Throw: None; Spell Resistance: no

You summon a 10 ft. swarm of floating, diminutive, magic daggers (treated as a swarm of bats with construct traits, a fly speed of 30 ft., and a swarm attack of 1d6 with wounding), which attacks all creatures within its area. (You may summon the swarm so that it shares the area of other creatures.) Each round you may spend a standard action to direct the swarm to move up to 25 ft., otherwise it pursues the nearest target.
